paragraphs.text: 1. MAY Dyaus the Lord of lauded wealth, and Earth stand by the man who offers sacrifice,
And may the Asvins, both the Gods, strengthen the worshipper with bliss.
2. As such we honour you, Mitra and Varuna, with hasty zeal, most blest, you who sustain the folk.
paragraphs.original: ता वां मित्रावरुणा धारयत्क्षिती सुषुम्नेषितत्वता यजामसि ।
paragraphs.translit: tā vāṃ mitrāvaruṇā dhārayatkṣitī suṣumneṣitatvatā yajāmasi |

paragraphs.text: So may we, through your friendship for the worshipper, subdue the fiends.
3. And when we seek to win your love and friendship, we who have precious wealth in our possession,
paragraphs.original: अधा चिन्नु यद्दिधिषामहे वामभि प्रियं रेक्णः पत्यमानाः ।
paragraphs.translit: adhā cinnu yaddidhiṣāmahe vāmabhi priyaṃ rekṇaḥ patyamānāḥ |

paragraphs.text: Or when the worshipper augments his riches let not his treasures be shut up
paragraphs.original: दद्वाँ वा यत्पुष्यति रेक्णः सम्वारन्नकिरस्य मघानि
paragraphs.translit: dadvām̐ vā yatpuṣyati rekṇaḥ samvārannakirasya maghāni

paragraphs.text: 4. That other, Asura! too was born of Heaven. thou art, O Varuna, the King of all men.
paragraphs.original: असावन्यो असुर सूयत द्यौस्त्वं विश्वेषां वरुणासि राजा । मूर्धा रथस्य चाकन्नैतावतैनसान्तकध्रुक्
paragraphs.translit: asāvanyo asura sūyata dyaustvaṃ viśveṣāṃ varuṇāsi rājā | mūrdhā rathasya cākannaitāvatainasāntakadhruk

paragraphs.text: The chariot's Lord was well content, forbearing to anger Death by sin so great.
This sin hath Sakaputa here committed. Heroes who fled to their dear friend he slayeth,
When the Steed bringeth down your grace and favour in bodies dear and worshipful.
6. Your Mother Aditi, ye wise, was purified with water even as earth is purified from heaven.
paragraphs.original: युवोर्हि मातादितिर्विचेतसा द्यौर्न भूमिः पयसा पुपूतनि ।
paragraphs.translit: yuvorhi mātāditirvicetasā dyaurna bhūmiḥ payasā pupūtani |

paragraphs.text: Show love and kindness here below: wash her in rays of heavenly light.
paragraphs.original: अव प्रिया दिदिष्टन सूरो निनिक्त रश्मिभिः
paragraphs.translit: ava priyā didiṣṭana sūro ninikta raśmibhiḥ

paragraphs.text: 7. Ye Twain have seated you as Lords of Wealth, as one who mounts a car to him who sits upon the pole, upon the wood.
paragraphs.original: युवं ह्यप्नराजावसीदतं तिष्ठद्रथं न धूर्षदं वनर्षदम् ।
paragraphs.translit: yuvaṃ hyapnarājāvasīdataṃ tiṣṭhadrathaṃ na dhūrṣadaṃ vanarṣadam |

paragraphs.text: These our disheartened tribes Nrmedhas saved from woe, Sumedhas saved from Woe.
paragraphs.original: ता नः कणूकयन्तीर्नृमेधस्तत्रे अंहसः सुमेधस्तत्रे अंहसः
paragraphs.translit: tā naḥ kaṇūkayantīrnṛmedhastatre aṃhasaḥ sumedhastatre aṃhasaḥ
